answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock scarce, slashable stake before earning trust. Rewards and voting weight scale with stake, not account count, and proven coordinated abuse burns the locked funds. A delta in reputation therefore comes from costly, repeated performance. The reef is the ledger that records stake and claims; pigment may label an identity, but it grants no power. Creating fake accounts is easy; giving each influence requires capital the attacker risks losing.
